# 🚀 LangGraph Exploration (Basic ➝ Advanced)

Welcome to the **LangGraph Exploration Repo**!  
This repository is dedicated to learning and experimenting with **LangGraph** — from **basic building blocks** to **advanced chatbot orchestration** with **LLMs**.

If you’re new to LangGraph, think of it as a framework that allows you to **orchestrate LLM applications using graph-based workflows**. Instead of hardcoding `if-else` logic everywhere, you define **nodes** (LLMs, tools, memory, human) and **edges** (how the conversation flows), and LangGraph handles the execution flow.

---

## 📂 What’s Inside
This repo is structured to take you step by step from basics to advanced concepts of Langgraph
Most of the tutorials dont go beyond basics, so if you dont like to go through docs, this repo might be helpful.
---

## ⚡ Getting Started

### 1. Clone the Repo
```bash
git clone https://github.com/pratirath06/Langgraph-basics-to-advanced.git
cd Langgraph-basics-to-advanced
```

### 2. Setup
```sh
# Create your Groq API Key
echo 'GROQ_API_KEY=your_groq_api_key' >> .env

pip install uv
uv sync --frozen

source venv/bin/activate   # Mac/Linux
venv\Scripts\activate      # Windows
```

### 3. Try it yourself!
